mapper.select: SELECT merchant_id FROM shop WHERE id=#{shopId} AND region=#{region} AND is_deleted=FALSE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shop WHERE id=#{shopId} AND region=#{region} AND is_deleted=FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO support_ticket(region, requester_type, requester_id, shop_id, subject, content, status) VALUES(#{region}, #{requesterType}, #{requesterId}, #{shopId}, #{subject}, #{content}, 1)
INSERT INTO ticket_message(ticket_id, sender_type, sender_id, content) VALUES(#{ticketId}, #{senderType}, #{senderId}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE support_ticket SET updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND region=#{region}
UPDATE support_ticket SET status=#{status}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND region=#{region}
mapper.sql: t.id, t.region, t.requester_type, t.requester_id, t.shop_id, t.subject, t.content, t.status, t.created_at, t.updated_at, s.name AS shop_name
FROM support_ticket t LEFT JOIN shop s ON s.id=t.shop_id
